input.brief: Dubai turnkey interior contractor that fabricates steel, joinery and glazing in-house under one contract

direction.name: The place carries it
direction.idea: For a place, the photograph is the argument. One full-bleed image of where you would be standing fills the first screen, and the design steps back: the name sits along the bottom edge like a film title, or small in a corner, and nothing else interrupts the view. The page that follows keeps that restraint: few words, large pictures, long pauses. The designer's work here is editing: choosing the one frame that makes someone want to be there, and then not covering it.
direction.composition: First screen: a single photograph at 100vw by 100svh, focal point kept clear of text. The name is set either very large (14–20vw) hugging the bottom edge with 16–24px of margin, or small (20–28px) top-left with a one-line description bottom-left. Navigation is two to four words in the top corners in the same small size. If text sits on the image, a soft neutral scrim under the text area only. Below, sections alternate between a short centred or left-set paragraph in a narrow column (max 52ch) with wide empty margins, and photographs shown large: one full-bleed, then a pair at different sizes, then one portrait offset to the right. Practical information (hours, address, rates, booking) is gathered once near the end in a plain two-column block.
direction.typography: A face with some grace for the name; small, calm, well-spaced text everywhere else. Sentence case. Body 17–19px with leading around 1.55.
direction.colour: Neutral paper or deep neutral ground chosen to flatter the photographs; text ink drawn from the darkest tone in the imagery. Colour lives in the pictures.
direction.imagery: The dealt set is the palette. Choose four to six photographs with the same light. The hero image must have a calm area for the name. Full-bleed or large with square corners; never thumbnails, never a carousel of ten.
direction.photoTreatment: Leave photographs ungraded. If text overlays one, darken only the area behind the text with a neutral scrim.
direction.richness: The photographs, at full size, uninterrupted. Empty paper around short text makes the next image land harder.
direction.pitfalls: A weak hero photograph cannot be fixed by typography; pick again. Do not stack a headline, a paragraph and two buttons on the image. Do not use a booking bar that covers the bottom of the view; one small action is enough.

hero.name: Sentence with a photo strip
hero.blueprint: A warm flat ground with no navigation bar. One sentence of four or five words runs as a single line of condensed capitals at clamp(120px, 13vw, 200px), sitting on the vertical centre and reaching edge to edge inside 28px margins. Where one word of the sentence would be, a strip of photograph takes its place: a frame exactly one cap-height tall (set in em) and 45–50% of the viewport wide, ratio near 5:1, corners radiused 14px, `object-fit: cover`. Build the line as a flex row with `align-items: baseline` and give the strip `flex: 1` so words and picture always fill the width. The photograph shows the thing the sentence names: a wide view of the place, taken from above or along a horizon, so it survives the letterbox crop. The top third of the screen is empty apart from a 15px wordmark top-left and two text links top-right. About 150px under the sentence the single action sits centred as a small solid button. One supporting sentence at 22px, max 44ch, is centred 48px above the bottom edge.
hero.mobile: The sentence breaks into two lines at 21vw with the strip between them: the first words, then the photograph as a 2:1 frame at full width minus 16px margins with the same 14px corners, then the remaining words. The block is centred vertically. The action button sits 32px under the last line and the supporting sentence under that at 16px. The top links collapse to one word.
hero.headline: A sentence of four or five short words, about 14 characters of type in total, whose missing word is the photograph.

type.note: A sturdy grotesque kept at regular weight even at 88px, so the page reads as composed rather than loud. Suits finance, infrastructure and research pages that need to look sober and current.

palette.name: Graphite and orange
palette.note: Graphite and cool light-grey sections alternate, graphite taking about two thirds, and photographs are desaturated so nothing competes. Safety orange marks the buttons, one thick solid bar across the top of the page and the highlighted item in a list or chart.

photos.title: Architecture
photos.note: structure, lines, bridges, facades and building interiors
photos.treatment: Leave photographs ungraded. If text overlays one, darken only the area behind the text with a neutral scrim.

motion.name: Shutter image
motion.description: The one hero or showcase image opens from an edge with a clip-path over about 1.1 seconds while the picture inside settles from 1.12 scale to rest. Use it once, on the image that matters most; later images simply are there. Recipe: 'Image shutter' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: Heading captions a panorama
sections.blueprint: The section is exactly 100svh. Its top third holds a two-line heading of three to six words at clamp(48px, 6.5vw, 96px) with leading 0.95, either centred or flush left on the page margin. 28px beneath the heading sit two small captions side by side, each two lines at 13px and 150px wide with a 48px gap, aligned to the heading (centred as a pair, or both starting at its left edge). 40px below them a full-bleed photograph begins and runs off the bottom of the viewport: it is 100vw wide at 21:9 or wider, and only its top 55–60svh is visible before the fold, the rest arriving with scroll. The heading therefore reads as a large caption to the picture. On an object-led page the image is the object on a flat dark panel inset by the page margin instead of bleeding to the edges.
sections.mobile: Heading at 12vw on two lines, left-aligned, taking the top 30% of the screen. The two captions merge into one four-line block at 14px. The photograph begins at 45% of the screen height in a 4:5 crop, full-bleed, and runs off the bottom.

sections.name: The printed menu sheet
sections.blueprint: The list is one tall sheet of paper. A filled paper-colour panel 640px wide sits centred, or offset to columns 7–12, on a contrasting flat ground or a full-bleed photograph, with square corners and its top and bottom edges cut into shallow scallops by `clip-path` or an SVG `mask`. Inside, 64px padding and a centred, symmetrical setting like a printed card: the venue or section name at 40–48px, a one-line note at 15px, then three or four groups 56px apart. Each group opens with its name at 22px, centred. Items follow at 17px with 16px between them: the dish or service at the left of a 420px measure, the price at the right with tabular figures, and a one-line description at 14px in the soft ink under the name. Alignment alone links name and price; there are no leaders. The sheet ends with the opening hours as two centred lines. Holds 12–24 items.
sections.mobile: The sheet spans the screen with 10px of ground showing at each side and 28px padding; the scalloped edges stay at top and bottom. The measure is the full inner width and prices stay right-aligned. Group names at 20px, items at 16px.

sections.name: Photographs down a diagonal
sections.blueprint: Three stages, three photographs of different sizes placed along a falling diagonal on the 12-column grid. Stage one: a 3:4 portrait in columns 1–4. Stage two: a 1:1 square in columns 6–8, its top edge 220px lower than the first photograph's top. Stage three: a 16:10 landscape in columns 8–12, starting 180px below the bottom of the second. Each stage's text sits in the gap the stagger leaves: a paragraph of up to 36ch at 17px, top-aligned with its photograph and placed in the columns to its right (to its left for the third). Each paragraph opens with a bold run-in phrase that carries the order: 'On the first day', 'A week later', 'By the end'. Square corners; no arrows or connecting marks. The heading, two to four words at clamp(36px, 4vw, 64px) in a light weight, sits alone in columns 7–12 at the very top, level with the first photograph's top edge.
sections.mobile: The diagonal becomes alternating widths: the first photograph at 100%, the second at 62% flush right, the third at 78% flush left. Each paragraph follows its photograph on that photograph's left edge at 16px. 56px between stages. The heading sits above at 30px.

sections.name: One frame, three distances
sections.blueprint: A wrapper 300vh tall holds a sticky stage of 100svh. On the stage one frame is centred: 30vw wide at 4:5, square corners, overflow hidden. Inside it the same photograph is shown at three distances as the reader scrolls: the whole subject, then scaled to 180% toward one detail, then to 320% on a second detail (transform: scale with a transform-origin per stage, 700ms ease, switched by IntersectionObserver on three invisible markers). The sentence is delivered in halves: its first two or three words sit above the frame at clamp(56px, 8vw, 130px), centred; the last words arrive below the frame at the second stage, overlapping the frame's bottom edge by 0.3em. At the third stage one caption of 28ch at 17px appears to the right of the frame, top-aligned. The two halves together are the heading and stay within two lines.
sections.mobile: The frame grows to 70vw at 4:5 and stays sticky at centre. The first half of the sentence sits above it at 13vw, the second half below it at the same size. The third-stage caption appears under the sentence at 16px, centred.

sections.name: Full panels, one midline row
sections.blueprint: Four to seven consecutive panels, each 100vw by 100svh, butted together with no gap. Each panel is one photograph of the project cropped much tighter than its frame (`object-fit: cover` with the image scaled to 130%), so a detail fills the screen. The same three-part text row sits at exactly 50% of the height on every panel, in white with `mix-blend-mode: difference` or over a neutral dark scrim band 90px tall: the date or year at the left margin at 15px, the project title in capitals at clamp(22px, 2vw, 30px) starting 10% in from the left, and one fact (location, client, number of pieces) at the right margin at 15px. Because the row never moves, scrolling reads like turning plates in a book. Panels may be `position: sticky; top: 0` so each slides over the last. There is no section heading; the first panel's title row is the heading.
sections.mobile: Panels are 100vw by 82svh. The row drops to the bottom of each panel, 20px above its edge: the title at 22px on the first line, then date at the left and fact at the right on a second line at 13px, over the same scrim band.

sections.name: Three photographs, then a field
sections.blueprint: Two parts with no gap between them. First, a strip of three photographs butted edge to edge across the full viewport, each one third wide and 40svh tall, `object-fit: cover`, no gutters and no captions; give all three the same treatment. Directly beneath, a band in one flat palette colour, about 44svh tall. In the band, columns 1–7: the closing statement at 26–30px over three lines in the band's assigned ink, with exactly one phrase underlined by a 4px bar (`text-decoration-thickness: 4px; text-underline-offset: 6px`), and that phrase is the link; two lines at 16px follow 32px lower. In the lower-right corner, columns 11–12, a small portrait photograph (4:5, about 150px wide) sits 40px from the band's edges: the person who will answer. There is no button; the underlined phrase is the action.
sections.mobile: The strip becomes one full-width photograph at 4:3 with the other two side by side beneath it at half width each, still gutterless. The band follows: statement at 22px, the two small lines, and the portrait at 96px wide in the bottom-right corner.

sections.name: Visit card on a photograph
sections.blueprint: A full-bleed photograph of the place, 100vw by 100svh, carries one solid card and nothing else. The card is a filled panel in the paper colour, fully opaque, 380px wide with 8px corners and 32px padding, placed in the upper-right corner 60px from the top and right edges (or the upper-left: pick the corner where the photograph is calmest). It holds, top to bottom: a two- or three-word title at 28px in a light weight; the address on two lines at 16px; the opening hours as three rows with days at the left and times right-aligned in tabular figures; the phone number; then, flush with the card's bottom edge and spanning its width, a solid booking button 52px tall. The card may be `position: sticky; top: 60px` inside a taller section so it holds while the photograph scrolls beneath it. The photograph's focal point must stay clear of the card. No heading outside the card.
sections.mobile: The photograph is 100vw by 70svh. The card leaves the corner: it spans the width with 16px margins and overlaps the photograph's bottom edge by 80px, so image and card interlock. The booking button is full width, 56px tall, at the card's bottom.

sections.name: Photograph half, menu half
sections.blueprint: A split footer one viewport tall. The left half is a single photograph filling columns 1–6 edge to edge, cropped hard by the left and bottom viewport edges: a close crop of the page's main subject, larger than it appeared anywhere above. The right half, on a flat field, is the site's menu set large: five or six section names stacked as links at about 2.6vw bold, 28px apart, starting at column 8 and 80px from the top. Rows are separated by space only; on hover a row's label shifts right by 12px and the others drop to the softer ink. Under the menu, 64px lower, two short blocks at 15px side by side: contact and social. The legal line runs along the very bottom of the right half at 12px. The wordmark sits small at the top of the right half, on the menu's left edge.
sections.mobile: The photograph leads at full width and 50svh, cropped tight. The menu follows on the flat field at 8vw per item with 20px between items, then contact and social stacked at 15px, then the legal line at 12px. The wordmark sits small above the menu.

references.name: White Desert
references.idea: One word, the destination, set a third of the screen tall over footage like a film title card; sheer scale stands in for remoteness.
references.hero: Full-bleed video (the view from an aircraft window over an ice shelf, darkly vignetted by the window frame) fills the viewport. Faint vertical hairlines divide it into six columns. Top-left, three outlined rectangular nav buttons about 120 by 40px with 6px gaps; top-right, two more; between them a small white mountain logo over a condensed caps name. One condensed uppercase word spans almost the full width at 17.8vw, white, centred, anchored so its baseline sits about 35px above the bottom edge. At mid-height a two-line italic serif tagline at about 16px hangs on the first column line at left, and a film-play label sits between two hairlines at right.
references.type: Three voices: Oswald 400 uppercase for the giant word and footer wordmark (up to 22vw); Cardinal Classic Long, a light high-contrast serif, for caps statements near 32px and italic taglines; Inter Tight 14px for nav and body. Body to display is roughly an 18x jump.
references.colour: #040608 #ffffff #e9e7e1 #1f2b4d #f5821f #95979a — Footage and near-black open the page; content sections flip to pure white with navy serif type and end on a warm grey footer. One small orange tab is the only accent. Cool overall.
references.imagery: Aerial and wildlife footage and stills of ice, penguins and rust-coloured rock peaks, natural cool grade, always full-bleed with square corners; trips appear as tall vertical image slices set side by side with no gaps.
references.layout: A six-column grid made visible by faint full-height hairlines runs through every section. Text blocks are small and hung off column lines, often starting at column two or three, with large voids around them. Full-bleed image screens alternate with nearly empty white text screens.

sections.description: A white screen with the six vertical hairlines still showing. A serif caps paragraph at about 32px, navy, light weight and tight leading, occupies only columns two to four, left-aligned with its first line indented by half the measure. Above its top-left sits a small italic label ringed by a loose hand-drawn pen scribble. An orange vertical tab with rotated text is fixed to the right edge.

Leaving the hero, the giant word blurs and dissolves into white mist that becomes the next section's background. Later a full-viewport photograph of jagged rock peaks in snow bleeds to all four edges, with a narrow 13px paragraph from the white section above overlapping its top edge at a column line, so text and image interlock rather than stack.

A serif caps heading at about 40px sits left of centre with a long pencil-like scribble underline that extends well past the words on both sides. Below, a full-width band of four vertical image panels with no gaps and unequal widths, like an accordion; the first panel carries a two-line italic serif title in white at its top-left.

Warm grey field. The top row holds a small logo, three columns of grey link lists with italic serif group headings and, at right, a stack of square-cornered off-white tiles (a video thumbnail, two half-width buttons, one full-width). Beneath, the brand name in navy condensed caps runs edge to edge at about 22vw. A final strip has award badges left, a centred italic quotation and legal links right.

steal: Set a single place name in condensed caps at about 18vw, centred and anchored to the bottom edge of full-bleed footage, with everything else on screen at 14-16px.
Leave the column grid visible as faint full-height hairlines across video, white and footer sections, and hang small text blocks off those lines.
Ring or underline small serif labels with a loose hand-drawn pen scribble to put one human mark into an otherwise strict layout.

references.name: Tengile Malamala Collection
references.idea: Let the land and animals carry everything: one staggered hairline-serif headline over aerial footage, then cream pages of olive-green serif text with photographs placed at uneven sizes.
references.hero: Aerial river footage fills the viewport, slightly darkened. Three small white caps items sit on the top edge: an enquiry link hard left, a stacked three-line wordmark centred, 'menu' hard right. The headline is two words on two lines in thin serif capitals about 8.3vw tall: the first line starts 10% from the left, the second is indented to 40% and ends near 90%, so the pair steps diagonally across the middle third. Below, starting at the 50% line, a three-line serif sentence at about 20px and a small white square-cornered button with a separate arrow square beside it. The lower third is left to the water.
references.type: PP Fragment at hairline weight (220): capitals for the 120px headline, sentence case for 28-36px olive statements. Inter at 11-16px for labels, nav and small paragraphs. Three serif sizes, two sans sizes; the serif never goes bold.
references.colour: #f5eee9 #5c6e21 #181608 #e3e1d4 #ffffff — Warm cream page with every word, large or small, in one olive green; the footer inverts to a solid olive field with cream text. Photography supplies all other colour.
references.imagery: Wildlife and lodge photography, natural and saturated, square corners, no overlays. Mixed aspect ratios placed at different widths and vertical offsets; lodge listings use equal landscape triplets; hero and closing band are full-bleed aerials.
references.layout: Narrow 16px outer margins and a twelve-column grid used asymmetrically: label and small paragraph in the left columns, the large statement starting at the midpoint. Sections alternate between loosely scattered image pairs and tidy three-up rows.

sections.description: Cream field. A tiny sans caps label top-left. A 28px olive serif paragraph of eight lines occupies only the right half, starting at the midpoint. Far below on the left, a five-line 12px sans paragraph about 180px wide. Images are placed loose: a landscape elephant photo under the right text, a tall leopard portrait lower at the left margin, a wide crop of elephant legs upper right of the next screen. No two share a top edge or width.

A tiny caps label, then an olive serif statement at about 36px running the full width for four lines. Beneath: a sub-label, a 12px paragraph held to a third of the width, then three equal landscape photos with 8px gutters spanning margin to margin, each captioned below in small serif. The same block repeats for a second category; one tile is dimmed with a short caps line laid over it to mark it as not yet open.

A full-bleed aerial of an elephant crossing a sandbank with a short serif statement, a small sans paragraph and the white button-plus-arrow pair set in the right half only. It butts directly against a solid olive footer: five columns of small cream links under tiny caps headings in the top third, a large empty green area beneath, and a legal line along the bottom edge.

steal: Stagger a two-line headline: first line from the left margin, second indented by 30% so the pair steps diagonally across the image.
Set every piece of text in a single brand colour on cream and make the footer that same colour as a solid field.
Split the button into two adjacent squares, label and arrow, with a 4px gap, small and square-cornered, instead of one pill.

references.name: Kononenko Architectural Bureau
references.idea: Let the renders do the talking: one full-bleed visualisation, a name set half in grotesk and half in serif, then alternating oversized sans and serif statements on white.
references.hero: A single architectural render fills the viewport edge to edge: a low grey metal-clad building under a large overcast sky, wild grass across the bottom third. Type is white and tiny except for the name. Top-left at a 24px margin, the bureau name is stacked on three lines at 13px. Top-right, four links run inline separated by commas, the current one underlined. Bottom-left, the name repeats at 60px (4.2vw) on two tight lines, the first two words in grotesk and the last word in a serif at the same size. No button, no scrim, no tagline; the sky takes the upper 45% untouched.
references.type: Two faces (digest names are obfuscated): a tight neo-grotesk at −0.03em and a soft high-contrast serif, mixed inside one line in the name. Section statements alternate: centred sans at about 6.5vw, then left-aligned serif at 4.5vw with a first-line indent. Labels are 9px.
references.colour: #ffffff #000000 #b7b7b9 #7c8050 #3d3a36 #9a9a9a — White pages with black type; colour comes only from the renders' overcast greys, greens and dark timber. The footer inverts to solid black with white letters.
references.imagery: Photoreal architectural visualisations in muted natural light, shown full-bleed at wide panoramic crops with square corners and no overlays; one loose black ink sketch on white stands in for process.
references.layout: 24px outer margins. Full-bleed image bands alternate with white type-only screens. Big statements either centre or run the full width; small data sits in narrow columns with tiny serif labels left of sans values, and hairline tables are inset to the right-hand third.

sections.description: White screen with a two-line sans heading centred at roughly 6.5vw, tight leading, taking the top third. Directly beneath, two tiny grey captions of two lines each sit side by side, each about 130px wide, centred as a pair. A full-bleed panoramic render starts immediately below and runs off the bottom, so the heading reads as a caption to the picture.

Far left, three label and value pairs at 9px (serif label, sans value) stack in a 150px column. From 34% across, a five-line serif paragraph at about 22px runs to 90% of the width. 120px lower a second row repeats the logic for achievements: a label at far left, then two narrow list columns of awards and publications at 9px with generous gaps between them.

A four-line serif statement at 4.5vw spans the full width, left-aligned with the first line indented about 3% and leading under 1. Below it, pushed into the right-hand 35% of the page, an offices table: a tiny label hangs to its left, and each row holds office type, country and city in grey, an address, and a small arrow, divided by hairlines at 18px row height.

Solid black. A top band of five tiny columns (name, navigation, media, address, hours), each a grey label beside a white list. Then a four-letter abbreviation of the name in white grotesk fills the entire width, letters about 45% of the viewport tall and touching both edges, with a single 8px legal line squeezed beneath.

steal: Set the last word of a sans headline in an upright serif of the same size to give a plain name a signature without any graphic device.
Alternate statement voices down the page: a centred grotesk heading, then a full-width left-aligned serif paragraph at display size with a first-line indent.
Close with an abbreviation of the name scaled until it touches both edges of a black footer, with all practical links shrunk to 9px above it.
